title: Flow Node Zoom Lods
description: Introduce six zoom LOD tiers for DAG/flow nodes mirroring puzzle 2d: zoomed out shows horizontal centered name, zooming in reveals three sections with dividers, vertical name, port labels, and handles.
summary: Introduced six puzzle-2d-aligned zoom LOD tiers for DAG nodes in the shared renderer. Far zoom (minimap/overview/compact) collapses nodes to fill+stroke with horizontal centered names; normal+ adds section dividers, vertical names, and handle dots; detail/micro adds port labels and control value text. Flow widget chrome (slider/note/preview) is gated behind normal+. Added unit tests and a wheel-zoom runtime probe confirming all six bands transition correctly.
